parameters.query:
SELECT
  voiceover_run_id::text AS voiceover_run_id,
  script_version_id::text AS script_version_id,
  narration,
  language_code,
  target_duration_seconds,
  locale,
  voice_name,
  sku_family,
  character_count,
  usage_idempotency_key
FROM factory.begin_voiceover($1::uuid);

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ input: { text: $json.narration }, voice: { languageCode: $json.locale, name: $json.voice_name }, audioConfig: { audioEncoding: 'MP3' } }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  voiceover_id::text AS voiceover_id,
  duration_ms,
  audio_sha256
FROM factory.complete_voiceover(
  $1::uuid,
  $2::text,
  $3::text,
  $4::bigint,
  $5::integer,
  $6::integer,
  $7::integer,
  $8::text
);

SELECT voiceover_status, job_status, usage_state
FROM factory.fail_voiceover($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::boolean);
